extension.summary: Native Kodi Netflix browsing with playback in a trusted DRM client
extension.description: A clean Netflix add-on for Kodi. Browsing (home rows, box art, My List, search, episodes, profiles) is served by a single embedded Microsoft Edge WebView2 window that the add-on queries through Netflix's own in-page data client over localhost — so there is no DRM, no key handling and no fragile API reverse-engineering. Playback runs in that same WebView2 window (Netflix-trusted; up to 4K via PlayReady SL3000 on Windows) with the Kodi subtitle font applied, or is delegated to the OS browser/app. Each user signs in to their own account. Windows only for embedded mode; other platforms delegate.
